meta.name: agent-hierarchy
meta.description: Designs orchestrator-and-subagent hierarchies for a repository — splitting agents by exclusive write surface, pairing every producer with an independent auditor, and enforcing the split with a script that runs in CI. Use this whenever the user wants to set up, expand, audit, or fix a multi-agent or subagent structure for a codebase; asks how to divide work between agents; wants agent charters, roles, or a surface map written; or is hitting agents that collide on the same files, review their own work, or drift from their remit. Also use when sizing a roster or deciding whether a new agent is justified.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划多代理分工并自动校验职责边界
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你在管理代码库中的多个子代理，需要清晰的职责边界与相互审计。
copy.tagline_en: Design multi-agent division of labor with automatic boundary checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple subagents in a codebase and need clear boundaries and mutual audits.

howto.what: 会按“写面”而非主题拆分代理:先盘点仓库文件,提出每个代理独占的修改范围,配对生产者与独立审查者,生成一张写面地图和 CI 校验脚本,由主会话统一提交。
howto.when: 当你说要搭建、扩展、审查或修复代码库的多代理结构,问怎么给代理分工,或代理互相冲突、自审、越界时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个仓库的代理结构按独占写面拆一下
say.note: 它会先盘点文件,再提出代理名单和写面地图。

say.text: 两个代理总改同一批文件,怎么分开?
say.note: 会按写面拆分,并给每个生产者配独立审查者。

say.text: 给现有代理补一份章程,格式照 playbook
say.note: 会按顺序在写面地图和守卫脚本之后补写。

howto.what_en: It arranges agents by exclusive write surface, not topic: inventories the repository, proposes a roster where no two agents share files, pairs each producer with an independent auditor, records a surface map, and wires a CI guard script. The main session commits everything.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up, expand, audit, or fix a multi-agent or subagent structure in a codebase, ask how to divide work between agents, or report agents colliding on files, reviewing their own work, or drifting from their remit.

say_en.text: Split this repo's agent structure by exclusive write surface
say_en.note: It will inventory files first, then propose a roster and surface map.

say_en.text: Two agents keep editing the same files; how do we separate them?
Add a charter for an existing agent, following the playbook format
say_en.note: It will write it after the surface map and guard are in place.
